title: Ningbo: Khumoyun Sultanov vs Naoya Honda
rules:
This market refers to the tennis match between Khumoyun Sultanov and Naoya Honda in the Ningbo, China, Qualifying, originally scheduled for October 25, 2026 at 10:00PM ET.

This market will resolve to 'Khumoyun Sultanov' if Khumoyun Sultanov advances against Naoya Honda. This market will resolve to 'Naoya Honda' if Naoya Honda advances against Khumoyun Sultanov.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or a winner has not been determined by November 8, 2026, 11:59 PM ET (14 days after the scheduled start), this market will resolve to 50-50. If the match begins but is not completed, and one player advances due to the opponent's retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve to the player who advances. If the match ends in a walkover (player withdraws before the start and the other advances automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.
